assessment.nobel_worthiness: Established, with rigorous kinetics on ruthenium-modified proteins, that electron transfer through protein matrices is governed by distance, driving force and reorganization energy, with the intervening medium tunable by pathway. This is a physical mechanism for biological energy conversion stated quantitatively, the kind of principle underlying respiratory chains and photosynthesis. Originality and lasting impact are high.
assessment.attribution: Two named people with a coherent, long-running joint program; this fits a clean prize. Marcus (1992) and Hopfield and Beratan-Onuchic theory are adjacent, so the experimental demonstration of tunneling timetables is the specific contribution to be credited. Harry Gray is the clear leader; Winkler is the sustained co-author.
assessment.maturity: Over three decades of independent confirmation, widely in textbooks. Recognition is not premature and arguably overdue; the age of the principal is a practical timing consideration.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views the work as sufficiently distinct from Marcus theory already recognized in 1992.

Whether the prize would rest on a line of work rather than a single discovery, and whether other experimental contributors (for example the Dutton and Moser group on natural proteins) have comparable claims, which the supplied credit does not include.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showed that liquid-liquid phase separation and condensate formation organize cellular compartments without membranes, giving physical-chemistry principles (multivalency, saturation, material properties) to cell organization. The concept is original, widely generative and has changed how cell biologists think about intracellular chemistry.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne published the founding P-granule liquid-droplet demonstration in 2009; Rosen supplied the multivalent-interaction biochemical framework (2012). Pappu and Mittag supply physical theory and sequence grammar but three laureates is the limit; this configuration is defensible but the allocation is contested.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly expanding field with strong independent support for the existence of condensates, but debate persists over which in-cell assemblies are truly phase-separated and over functional claims; the interpretation is still evolving.
uncertainties: Controversy over in vivo relevance and the rigor of phase-separation criteria.
Allocation between Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen, Pappu and Mittag; Brangwynne and Hyman may be considered the clear core.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors convert one base to another at a targeted genomic site without double-strand cleavage, a chemical-biology invention using engineered deaminases fused to Cas proteins. It is original, clearly defined, and has moved to clinical use, so lasting impact is evident.
assessment.attribution: Liu is the senior inventor and clearly decisive; Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor, including evolved TadA) were the lead experimentalists on the two editor classes. Kondo and Nishida's independent deaminase-based editing is a potential priority issue. A prize may need to be weighed against CRISPR (2020) and the placement of prime editing.
assessment.maturity: Replicated widely, with clinical-stage therapies; it is mature enough, though CRISPR was recently recognized and committee may prefer waiting for clinical outcomes.
uncertainties: Priority claim of Nishida and Kondo (Target-AID) compared with Komor and Liu.
Whether the committee sees this as chemistry or as medicine, and whether to credit Liu alone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase carries out multi-electron, multi-proton reduction of N2 at an unprecedented FeMo cofactor with a central carbide. The structure and mechanism (E4 state, hydride intermediates) are fundamental biological energy and electron/proton transfer chemistry, and relevant to the Haber-Bosch comparison.
assessment.attribution: Rees solved the first structures and the interstitial carbide with Einsle; Seefeldt and Dean built the mechanistic biochemistry; Ribbe contributed cofactor biosynthesis. Attribution among five is diffuse and a three-person configuration would omit key contributors.
assessment.maturity: Structures are established and reproduced, but the catalytic mechanism of N2 reduction is still not fully resolved; recognition may be partly premature on the mechanistic side.
uncertainties: Mechanism of N2 binding and reduction still debated.
Difficult three-person split among Rees, Einsle, Dean, Seefeldt and Ribbe.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Proton-coupled electron transfer is a central mechanistic concept in respiratory enzymes, photosynthesis and electrocatalysis, directly relevant to my own field, and the concerted versus stepwise distinction gives a physical framework with quantitative theory. Impact on bioenergetics and energy catalysis is considerable.
assessment.attribution: Meyer (early inorganic PCET), Mayer (concerted PCET and bond-weakening concepts), Hammes-Schiffer (theory) and Nocera (artificial photosynthesis) all contribute; the compound nature makes a clean three-name credit difficult and I am conscious that I may be biased toward this area.
assessment.maturity: The concept is mature and confirmed in many systems; the credit allocation, rather than the science, is the main issue.
uncertainties: The candidacy rests on a body of work rather than a single discovery.
Possible bias in my own assessment because of my research area; Nocera's role in the artificial-photosynthesis side is omitted from this trio.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy landscape theory and the funnel picture resolved the Levinthal paradox in physical terms, and Fersht's phi-value analysis gave experimental access to transition states. A physical principle for how proteins fold, with broad influence on structure prediction and biophysics.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic are the central theory pair; Fersht is the central experimental figure; Bryngelson and Dill have strong priority claims in the earlier funnel and lattice-model concepts, so credit is contested.
assessment.maturity: Concepts are well accepted and confirmed; the field has been strongly validated by recent prediction tools, though that arguably relates to other recognition.
uncertainties: Priority among Bryngelson, Wolynes, Dill and Onuchic.
Whether theory and experiment can be honored together within three laureates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation by PROTACs and molecular glue degraders is a new chemical modality, hijacking the ubiquitin-proteasome system, with strong mechanistic rationale and clinical entry. Originality high, with growing impact.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies developed the PROTAC concept (2001), Ciulli contributed structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary complex insight; Handa, Ito and others uncovered the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide/IMiDs, and attribution between PROTAC and molecular-glue strands is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Clinical validation is not yet complete; approved drugs are still pending, so recognition could be somewhat early.
uncertainties: Clinical efficacy not yet established for PROTACs.
Compound discovery with two strands (PROTACs and glue degraders) that may need different recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Serial femtosecond crystallography at X-ray free-electron lasers lets structures be recorded before radiation damage and enables time-resolved visualization of reaction dynamics, a method that makes mechanisms visible in the way I value. The concept (diffraction before destruction) is original.
assessment.attribution: Chapman and Hajdu are tied to the conceptual and early demonstration; Fromme and Schlichting were important for membrane proteins and time-resolved applications. Collaborative nature with many participants and the physics, as opposed to chemistry, character complicate attribution.
assessment.maturity: Method is established but its chemical and mechanistic payoff (time-resolved enzymes) is still being delivered; recognition may be a little premature compared with cryo-EM.
uncertainties: Whether the field is judged chemistry rather than physics, and large-collaboration attribution.
Whether time-resolved results have reached enough independent confirmation.
